about_the_game:
In this game, players take on the perspective of the victim, returning to the scene of the incident and attempting to escape a false accusation.

Gameplay Features:

  • Itch Progress Bar: Continuously click or press keys to relieve the itch caused by eczema. When the progress bar is filled, you succeed in your goal.

  • Awareness System: Another character in the library will occasionally look up and observe you. You must immediately stop scratching when they are alert, or you will be falsely accused.

  • Increasing Difficulty: As time passes, the other character’s alertness and reaction speed will gradually increase, raising the tension.

  • Easy to Pick Up, Highly Replayable: Each session is short and fast-paced, making it perfect for quick play sessions and repeated challenges.

Goal
Scratch without being noticed, fill the progress bar, and you win. If you fail, you can immediately try again, with each attempt presenting new challenges.
